svg.text: Every option lists newest first. From 480 up the total and stage sit in fixed columns, the stage in job rows' status spot.
Below 480 the total rides the title line and the stage leads the subline, as job rows do. The address and sent date drop.
At 320 only the job title truncates; the stage and total never do (C at 320 above). A's rows match C's.
Paid shows its date in --ok; Received and Approved stay --fg-2, in the job status's type. Plain words, no badge.
An invoice sent with no number reads just Invoice, and one with no total yet shows a lone dash.
A: on the Open tab only, so a long Done list never buries it. No invoices, no section. Show all opens the rest in place.
B: Open | Done | Invoices beside By date | By property needs about 437px of 343 at 375, and 369 of 288 at 320.
B: so on a phone the grouping folds into a 44px menu button, a change to an approved control. Tablet and laptop keep both.
C: no new control on My jobs. The Paid email and the Send invoice sent screen can link here too.
C: a list, so it runs to 1600 like My jobs, and the job page's header comes along at that width.
C: the account menu stays an anchored popover down to 320, sized to its words, 44px items on touch.
C rewords M14 (a page, not a section under My jobs); the spec changes if it's picked.
A row opens the invoice's file in Lightbox. The spec doesn't say; see concerns.
Link sessions see none of this: a job link opens only its own job, so /p and /p/invoices ask them to sign in (M16).
Refs: Remote invoice list (spec); Forest, Revolut Business and Wise list invoices on their own page with a back arrow.
